title: Machine repair times
intro: A maintenance team logged the time to repair twenty breakdowns of a packaging machine, in hours (h). Most repairs take one to two hours, but a few take much longer. Look at the histogram: the long tail is on the right. The mean (2.00 h) is above the median (1.55 h), and the skewness is positive, about 1.8. This is a positively (right) skewed distribution.
